youtube_description:
A video guide on installing EmuELEC on all (rootable & compatible) Amlogic Android TV boxes and sticks.
What version should you choose? 3.9 or 4.0?  Which is compatible with your board?
We go over common questions and demonstrate how to install EmuELEC.

►Links:
AIDA64, Terminal Emulator, and Root LibreELEC can be found at https://apkpure.com/
EmuELEC: https://github.com/EmuELEC/EmuELEC/releases
Etcher: https://www.balena.io/etcher/
CoreELEC Device Trees: https://coreelec.org/dtb/

►Where to buy a EmuElec compatible box:
HK1 Box: https://go.teampandory.com/hk1box
X96 Max: https://go.teampandory.com/x96max
GT King: https://go.teampandory.com/gtking
Odroid N2+: https://go.teampandory.com/odroidn2p

►Timestamps
@0:00- Intro
@0:18- Identifying our Android Box
@3:57- Which version of EmuELEC?
@4:43- Downloading and Writing the Image
@6:05- Device Trees / dtb file setup
@8:00- Android Box Setup
@8:26- EmuELEC first boot
@8:42- Conclusion
